THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 16, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:00 PM

Alejandra Ramirez, Chair  Jasmine Esparza, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Hilda Delgado, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MEGGAN.SORENSEN@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55006  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55007  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, March 19, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55008  Recommendation to conduct the first public hearing on the preparation of the
  Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-2026 Action Plan and accept public comment.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55009  Recommendation to approve the selection of Century Affordable Development for
  an award of HOME funds in the amount of up to $5,000,000; and

  Authorize the President or designee to enter into an Agreement to Negotiate
  Exclusively with Century for new construction of affordable rental housing units.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55010  Recommendation to receive and file Community Outreach Report.

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:05 PM, Chair Ramirez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Chambers, Minjarez, Sides, Melgarejo, Ramirez

  Commissioners Absent: Delgado, Esparza

Also present: Elizabeth Weithers, Housing Operations Officer, Kjell Stava, Real Estate Project
Coordinator, Nikki Amick, Development Project Manager, Adam Jacobs, Deputy City Attorney,
Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair Ramirez spoke; and announced that Director Delgado and Director Esparza were excused from
the meeting.

  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  and provided the President’s Report.
